sentiment.label: risk_off
sentiment.reason_it: Il VIX a 35.89 (+26.20%) indica panico (VIX>30) e il S&P 500 ha chiuso a 6,910.39 (-3.70%) nella seduta di venerdì, segnale di forte risk-off. Il DXY è a 103.81 (-0.09%) ma resta elevato, penalizzando gli asset rischiosi, mentre il Brent è in leggera ripresa (+0.64%) ma non basta a compensare l'inflazione da "virus". L'onda di guerra in Ucraina e le tensioni sul Golfo mantengono un contesto geopolitico bearish (+2 punti). Questi fattori convergono in uno score 9/10, con label risk_off.
sentiment.reason_en: The VIX at 35.89 (+26.20%) signals panic (VIX>30) and the S&P 500 closed at 6,910.39 (-3.70%) on Friday, a clear risk-off sign. The DXY sits at 103.81 (-0.09%) but remains high, weighing on risk assets, while Brent is only modestly up (+0.64%) and cannot offset the inflation "virus" narrative. Ongoing war in Ukraine and Gulf tensions keep the geopolitical backdrop bearish (+2 points). These drivers yield a 9/10 score with a risk_off label.

Commodities: Brent +0.64% non riesce a sostenere i mercati, mentre l'oro a $3,515.40 (-4.62%) segnala debasement. DXY -0.09% resta forte, rafforzando il bias bearish su risk assets. Crypto: Fear & Greed a 12 (Extreme Fear) e BTC -7.93% confermano la fuga verso liquidità.

audio_narrative_en.text: Good morning, welcome to the Price Alert Morning Briefing. The markets are observing the weekend pause.

audio_narrative_en.title: Market Closes
audio_narrative_en.text: In Friday's session, the S&P 500 fell 3.7% to 1690.49. The VIX rose 26.2% to 3589. The DXY fell 0.09% to 1381.81. The gold ounce dropped 4.6% to 305.4. Brent rose 0.6% to 92.57. The US 10Y Yield fell 2.8% to 4.91%. The BTP 10Y stayed stable at 4.68%. The STOXX 600 fell 0.8% to 63.13. The FTSE MIB fell 2.5% to 48,704. The Nikkei fell 5.1% to 56,407. audio_narrative_en.title: News and Outlook
audio_narrative_en.text: The waning influence of oil on bond markets could weigh on Monday's opening, raising fears of a volatility rebound. The Fed's bank balance sheet report suggests rates may stay stable, but the perception of high liquidity could push markets to seek higher yields. Discussions on the future of the chip war and US‑China stability could spark geopolitical tensions, causing tech stocks to wobble at the open.

audio_narrative_en.title: Macroeconomics
audio_narrative_en.text: No macro data were released over the weekend. The macro agenda resumes on Monday.

Ethereum, Solana and BNB see declines over 2%: Ethereum at €1.49, Solana at 66.9, BNB at 566.51. The Fear & Greed Index is 12, classified as extreme fear, suggesting caution for investors.

From hacked refrigerators and arson attacks to drone incursions on airfields, a wave of low-level sabotage and digital disruption has focused minds across Europe on the question of resilient societies.
